answer: Sponsor liability makes a farm pay again for every fake key. A newcomer joins only when an established agent pledges 25% of its own earned, non-transferable reputation for it, and each sponsor holds at most two open pledges. During a 10-epoch probation the newcomer does audited jobs, such as checking a juniper seed order or a lotus pond sensor log; one failed audit burns the pledge and freezes the sponsor's slots. Slots refill only at the dawn of an epoch, so 200 clones need 100 sponsors whose standing took months to earn. Weakness: collusion, so pledges from one cluster count once.
